findings.claim: The updated comment line was extended past the surrounding wrapped width; this is cosmetic only. More substantively, goal-prefixed keys (goal:<id>/odd/...) rely on the existing prefix stripping in curatedTopicKey, which is not shown in the diff and has no new test for the odd/session cases, so exclusion under a goal prefix is unverified by this change.

Adding 'odd' and 'session' to the exclusion list changes plain Engram sync behavior for existing observations: pages already promoted from odd/ or session/ topics are frozen (no longer refreshed by sync) and will appear as doctor warnings. The diff notes this consequence but provides no migration or retraction; owners relying on those pages being kept current by sync lose refresh silently, except for the doctor advisory.

evidence: Diff adds odd and session to excludedTopicPrefixes; Eligible and IneligibleReason share the map, so both sync sources and the doctor reason pick them up.
Tests cover odd/, session/, pinned odd/ override and odd-notes/ non-match; docs, README and spec updated consistently with five prefixes.
No explicit-option-ignored or regression on previously valid explicit promote paths seen: explicit and pinned paths still bypass the exclusion.
